analysis_md:
此题为三重积分交换次序问题。

$$
\int_0^1dx\int_0^xdy\int_0^y\frac{\sin z}{1-z}\,dz=\int_0^1dy\int_y^1dz\int_z^1\frac{\sin z}{1-z}\,dx
$$

$$
=\int_0^1dy\int_0^y\frac{\sin z}{1-z}(1-z)\,dz=\int_0^1dz\frac{\sin z}{1-z}\int_z^1(1-y)\,dy
$$

$$
=\frac12\int_0^1(1-z)\sin z\,dz=\frac12(1-\sin1)。
$$
